questions.title: Hair loss around your temples
questions.text: Finasteride and minoxidil are generally most effective for early to moderate male pattern hair loss at the crown and top of the scalp. They may still slow hair loss and support regrowth around the temples or hairline, but results in these areas are less predictable and vary between individuals.

questions.title: Treating extensive hair loss
questions.text: Finasteride and minoxidil are generally most effective for early to moderate male pattern hair loss at the crown and top of the scalp. If your hair loss is extensive, treatment may still help slow further hair loss, but significant regrowth is less likely. Results vary between individuals.
